distribution.narrative: Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) reported Pityophthorus micrographus at species rank, without identifying the nominate subspecies. The North China record is provisionally linked to Pityophthorus micrographus micrographus for database indexing only; it does not confirm the nominate subspecies in China. The original regional attribution remains broad.

host_note: Host information has not yet been reviewed for this checklist record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Pityophthorus micrographus micrographus (Linnaeus, 1758).
